import os, json, time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/mnt/TG_2TB/Projects/Apollo/argus/fake-google")

# Mark all unread as read: drop UNREAD label, record in audit like the backend does
marked = []
for m in s["messages"]:
    if "UNREAD" in m["labels"]:
        m["labels"] = [l for l in m["labels"] if l != "UNREAD"]
        marked.append(m["id"])
        s["audit"].append({"ts": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
                           "action": "gmail.mark_read", "message_id": m["id"]})

tmp = state_path.with_suffix(".tmp")
tmp.write_text(json.dumps(s, indent=2))
tmp.replace(state_path)
print("marked read:", marked)
EOF
